resources.string: Optional — you can skip this step.
Jarvis Prime is your local-first AI operating partner. This setup will explain what it does, what it asks for, and how you stay in control before any sensitive permission is requested.

Jarvis Prime helps you capture ideas, route work to the right agent, coordinate Hermes / AOS Council / Claude Code / Codex, and keep durable memory of your decisions. It runs as a companion, strategist, critic, operator, builder, and mobile voice capture surface.

You own final judgment. Risky actions — deploys, merges, OAuth, spending money, public posts, regulated claims — require explicit owner approval. Jarvis Prime will never silently take an owner-gated action.
You can change this later in settings.
No network calls, no real agents, no permissions required. Safe to explore the app.
Talk to a remote Hermes gateway you control. Needs a URL you provide and uses the INTERNET permission only.
Bridge to a local Termux Hermes install on this device via a local socket. No network permission needed beyond loopback.
Jarvis Prime can post notifications when an owner approval is needed or when a long task finishes. We will not ask Android for this permission until you tap Enable. The app works fully without it.
Mobile Voice Mode turns rough speech into clean task packets. The microphone permission is requested only when you tap Start voice setup. Mock mode never records audio.

The animated icon in the top bar is a status surface, not a system overlay. It tells you which mode is active, whether an approval is pending, and whether emergency stop is engaged. We are not asking for the system overlay permission in this wave.

Tap and hold the Jarvis icon for two seconds at any time to engage Emergency Stop. All pending agent actions are halted, any in-flight owner-gated request is cancelled, and notifications and voice are paused until you resume from settings.
Jarvis Prime is ready in the mode you picked. You can enable optional permissions later from settings, and Emergency Stop is always one long-press away.
